using the full 146-row surface without source-capped compact conversion
claiming promotion or private-holdout evidence from M1092

stop_condition: stop if compact caps would reduce the surface below minimum rows or physical pairs

stop if design routes directly to PPO

if caps make the surface too small, route to compact-cap audit
if replay sanity cannot be defined, route to proof-surface audit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1093 is design-only. It inherits M1092's level2 proof-surface scope and cannot upgrade to anticipatory self-identification without new temporal task evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1093 does not run scenarios. Future conversion/replay sanity still uses M1092 matched-current rows, not a pre-emergency warm-up window.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If compact conversion would collapse below source-diversity or replay-sanity thresholds, route to compact-cap audit rather than weakening the M1092 proof gate.
allowed_claims: compact conversion design for a passed level2 proof surface
no driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-level generalization claim

hypothesis: The M1092 source-balanced accepted rows can be converted into compact source-capped objective/replay corpora before any future PPO.
success_criteria: no training, PPO, promotion, or private holdout occurs
failure_criteria: objective or replay sanity is missing
decision_rule: M1093 designs compact objective/replay conversion for the M1092 accepted rows and admits a conversion run only if objective and replay sanity are specified. It cannot train, run PPO, promote, or use private holdout.
